rules.rationale: Moment.js describes itself as a legacy project in maintenance mode and discourages its use in new projects. Its mutable objects and large locale bundle are the usual reasons teams move off it.

alternatives.name: Intl and Date
alternatives.use: Formatting, relative time and simple arithmetic where the runtime's built-in support is enough

alternatives.name: Temporal
alternatives.use: Correct time zone and calendar arithmetic, where the target runtimes support it or a polyfill is acceptable

alternatives.name: date-fns
alternatives.use: Modular, functional helpers over native Date; small bundles when only a few functions are used

alternatives.name: Luxon
alternatives.use: Time zone and locale-heavy applications, with immutable DateTime objects

alternatives.name: Day.js
alternatives.use: A Moment-like API that eases a migration, with a small core
